unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision deletes 'Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them'. It also deletes the New York Gotterdammerung audience and every flood image, including the Seine rising over the Etoile, which the first draft kept. The anarchistic ferments now float free of Wagner, and 'New York knew better' is asserted without grounds.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The 'last great tragedy' and the Paris/New York contrast survive, as do Ternina and the Fluch-motif.

evidence.quote: Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion.
the frivolities of Paris had more than once included the rising of the Seine to drown out the Etoile or Montmartre
certain anarchistic ferments, and thought them proof of art. New York knew better than Baireuth what Wagner meant.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion' and the Seine clause after 'what Wagner meant'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: The plan says 'keep one' of the flood images; the revision keeps none.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The causal bridge from Wagner as catastrophe to the CCA party born 'under the inspiration of the Gotterdammerung' is weakened, as is the Paris-coquetting-with-catastrophe contrast.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Wagner no longer linked to the anarchistic ferments; all flood images cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops the thirty years of 'must go to Baireuth' and 'Thirty years earlier...immense stride'. As a result, 'Suddenly' loses its comic payoff and the education-arrived-too-late irony is gone. With 'parents and children' also cut, 'He joined them' points back to Mrs. Lodge alone.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Readers likely infer the Lodge family, and the 1876/1901 contrast partly survives.

evidence.quote: For thirty years or there-abouts, he had been repeating that he really must go to Baireuth.
For thirty years or thereabouts, he had been repeating that he really must go to Baireuth.
Suddenly Mrs. Lodge appeared on the horizon and bade him come. He joined them at the little old town of Rothenburg-on-the-Taube

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the 'For thirty years' sentence and the words 'parents and children'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required section content ('Mrs. Lodge summons him; Rothenburg and Baireuth').
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The scene's grouping becomes vague, and the elderly-delay irony that frames 1876 against 1901 disappears.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Baireuth delay cut; 'them' lacks antecedent

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source's light comes from the fact that all serve the power and work to increase it, which is the CCA's own duty to accelerate. The revision cuts this premise and the self-doubt about chaos. It replaces them with a bare 'But', so the light reads as an arbitrary reversal.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Paragraph 8 states the duty to accelerate, so an attentive reader can reconstruct the logic.

evidence.quote: No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it; but the conservative Christian anarchist saw light.
would certainly turn out to be chaos, since he would be equally obliged to deny the chaos.
drowned rhyme and reason. But the conservative Christian anarchist saw light.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it;' before the final clause.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required ('He admits the darkness: the throb...drowns rhyme and reason').
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The paradox tying the steam horse-power passage to the doctrine of acceleration is lost, along with Adams's qualifying uncertainty.
unresolved_should_improve.title: 'Saw light' loses its premise and its hedge

unresolved_should_improve.claim: After refusing opinion, the source still posits a value of inertia: a gap 'relatively the same' after a generation. At Hammerfest, that gap 'seemed to have suddenly become an abyss'. The first draft kept both; the revision cuts both.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The ice-cap image and the 'permanent line of division' still convey the divide.

evidence.quote: To recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back across the gulf to Russia, and the gap seemed to have suddenly become an abyss.
One might give a value as movement of inertia to the mass, and assume a slow acceleration
The acceleration was marvellous, and wholly in the lines of unity. Yet the nightmare of the glacial ice-cap still pressed down on him

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the 'One might give a value...relatively the same' sentence and the 'gap...abyss' sentence.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Supports the book-context thread of measuring history mechanically; a planning gap, since the essential list does not name it.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This loses the ironic move from epistemic refusal to measurement, which anticipates the later dynamic theory. It also loses the reason the McKinley acceleration widens the East–West divide.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Mechanical estimate of Russian inertia and the 'abyss' cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source follows the monkey's boast with the admission that his own figure 'was not necessarily ideal' and that he 'never ventured to dream of three' generations. It also adds the hint that only a man close to the foreign departments knew how much. The revision cuts all of this.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The required 'monkey and motor afraid of the bear' line survives.

evidence.quote: his own figure as monkey was not necessarily ideal or decorative, nor was he in the least sure what form it might take even in one generation. He had himself never ventured to dream of three.
Granting that his brother the bear lacked perfection in details, his own figure as monkey was not necessarily ideal or decorative
No man could guess what the Daimler motor and X-rays would do to him; but so much was sure; the monkey and motor were terribly afraid of the bear.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Granting that his brother the bear...dream of three.' to open paragraph 16.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Matches the voice profile's 'undercuts himself constantly'.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The La Fontaine episode loses its self-mockery and its answer to the three-generations question, so the verse risks reading as plain American complacency.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Monkey's self-satisfied verse left uncorrected

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops three lines the first draft kept: the 'more--infinitely more--chaotic' closer, 'courage to meet any contradiction, and intelligence enough to ignore it', and the old/new Teufelsdrockh comparison in paragraph 22. The Norway approach is also reduced to itinerary.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The main Teufelsdrockh image (V6, paragraph 19) survives intact.

evidence.quote: The new Teufelsdrockh, though considerably older than the old one, saw no clearer into past or future, but he was fully as much perplexed.
but it was more--infinitely more--chaotic and complex.
From the archaic ice-barrier to the Caspian Sea, a long line of division, permanent since ice and inertia first took possession

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the paragraph 22 Teufelsdrockh sentence and the paragraph 2 closer.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Matches the voice profile ('Aphoristic closers end paragraphs').
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This erodes the paragraph-ending aphorisms and the title figure's reprise, which carries Adams's self-ironic perplexity.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Aphoristic closers and late Teufelsdrockh echo stripped
